title: Brazil brings six ingredient suppliers to In cosmetics Asia 2026
summary: Six Brazilian companies specializing in beauty and personal care ingredients will take part in the 2026 edition of the in-cosmetics Asia trade show in Bangkok, Thailand, from November 3 to 5. Their participation will be coordinated by Beautycare Brazil, an internationalization program developed by the Brazilian Association of the Personal Hygiene, Perfumery and Cosmetics Industry (ABIHPEC) in partnership with the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (ApexBrasil).
